This one wouldn't be hard to do, I think. It's not really a technical benefit, more of a community thing.

I was thinking thtat Voat could potentially benefit, if nothing else but in participation/community spirit from having an official OC Day. On this day, users would be encouraged more than usual to submit their own content, whatever that may be, to subverses. Even if it's just a crappy pen and paper drawing to /v/art or wherever's appropriate, or their own work to /v/pixelart or /v/spritecomics or whatever else they want to do.

This'd be the day for Voat to show off what we can do, not just what we can post from other places. I really think that if people participated, this type of event could help create a better sense of community cohesion, and uniqueness. I also think having so many people, potentially, participate, would help encourage people who would normally be too shy or hesitant to post their work to join in. For people who aren't able/willing to post their own stuff, it could still be a day to celebrate people's original work.

It could be done once or twice a year, or something like that. More if enough people wanted it, I suppose. People could post as usual, but the idea is everyone would be storngly encourage to post their own content (except subverses where it's not applicable, such as /v/news). They could post as normal, just put something like [OC Day] at the front of their posts.
